meaning: A genuine accessibility consequence on ONE supplied graph G. If G is an actual-world production graph this concerns only that selected graph: no ordinary production-to-existential-ground dictionary, modal support-union WF, explanatory adequacy, metaphysical reality or philosophical premise truth is inferred.
